objective.primaryRule: the actual-profit role of the C24 selectable set (the independent and informed shortlists, Appendix A and the predeclared prior controls P01-P13): the highest development centre net among members passing Q1-Q5, ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label. A qualifying control holding it is the qualifying-incumbent fallback; with no qualified member there is no supported standalone candidate. The independent lane's own actual-profit holder (the independent primary) is identified separately for the chronological assessment (PROTOCOL.md §9.3).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct new centre proposals: independent 16,384 base / 32,768 cap per cutoff at C19, C21, C23 and C24 (two protected entry cells, each a 4,096 screen + 4 islands x 1,024, up to 12 islands); informed 8,192 base / 16,384 cap at C24 only (seeds + fine/near/broad designs + islands); 73,728 base / 147,456 cap in all, refinement moves counted apart. Backend evaluations (fresh; archive hits apart): independent search <= 750,000 per cutoff, informed search <= 400,000, qualification <= 120,000 per cutoff, validation neighbourhoods <= 10,000; total cap 4,000,000 (expected 0.7-1.6 M). Counted separately: screen centres, rung-1/2/3 and refinement centres and neighbours, qualification, folds, validation, retries, archive hits and worker compute time, per lane and per proposal origin (PROTOCOL.md §7.3).

deviations.description: the formal primary is the actual-profit role of the C24 selectable set including qualifying informed controls (qualifying-incumbent fallback); the independent lane's own primary is identified separately for chronology
deviations.justification: brief: Selection, risk and strength of evidence

deviations.description: Study 8 pipeline on the Growth·GDX genome only (58 genes, fine step); protected rise/breakout cells with 64/32 structural strata; promotion 1/4 centre net, 1/4 rank or robust, rest diversity or rank; shortlist slots incl. gate- and exits-alternatives
deviations.justification: brief: Search design and compute budget (protect entry families and structures; keep profit promotion beside robustness)

deviations.justification: brief: match perturbation instruments across controls and candidates
